beginner.background: Product manager new to identity and OAuth. Understands that agents call tools but has never designed an authorization flow.
beginner.goal: Explain to my team why an agent needs a distinct identity, what consent and scope mean, and when to ask a person before an action.
beginner.preference: Plain language first. Use familiar workplace examples, then show enough technical detail to discuss the design with engineers.

engineer.background: Staff IAM engineer who already works with OAuth, identity providers, service identities and policy enforcement.
engineer.goal: Design and review a cross-domain multi-agent workflow with recursive sub-agent delegation that keeps working after logout but preserves least privilege, revocation and attributable audit.
engineer.preference: Start with a concrete design problem and focus on decision logic, trust boundaries and negative tests.
